name: Social Architecture
short_description: How spatial configurations shape social behavior, from fostering spontaneous interaction and collaboration to creating isolation and loneliness.

components.name: Social Affordance Reading
components.description: Spatial layout provides affordances for social interaction (gathering, lingering, passing) that shape behavior patterns.

components.name: DMN Social Cognition
components.description: The default mode network couples spatial processing with social cognition, meaning spatial experience shapes social thinking.

components.name: Architectural Loneliness
components.description: Spaces that isolate occupants trigger acute social isolation stress with measurable neurobiological consequences.

components.name: Social Enrichment/Impoverishment
components.description: Chronic social richness or deprivation in built environments produces lasting neural plasticity effects.

components.name: Mirror Presence
components.description: Social presence and mirroring dynamics are modulated by spatial proximity, visibility, and acoustic coupling.

design_implications: Create varied social density zones: from intimate alcoves (2-person) to open gathering areas.
Position circulation paths to generate 'chance encounters' near communal amenities.
Avoid dead-end corridors and isolated workstations that produce architectural loneliness.
Provide visual social connectivity (sightlines to others) even in private work zones.

confidence_intervals.note: Effect sizes for spatial layout on spontaneous social interaction frequency.
